lede: Mountain Village Council meets Wednesday to vote on a sale price appreciation cap that will determine whether deed-restricted units actually stay affordable long-term — that one's worth showing up for. Across town, HARC takes a hard look at the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road, Ouray County holds three public hearings including a full repeal of a land-use code section, and the BOCC sits as the Housing Authority to work through affordable housing compliance at a moment when regional finances are under strain.

notable.stake: HARC votes on after-the-fact permit for unpermitted Elks Lodge pergola.

BOCC reviews housing authority compliance and holds a public hearing on land use.

Mountain Village Council votes on deed-restriction appreciation cap affecting affordability.
